build: Modwerk's linker (kit 0.7.0 parity): core-ar2 0.3 release (6b97dfb3…3e58) + rytm2_mods v1.2 main-rms-1.0-os1.74.elemod (cbd69edb…5d54), --version MR74
conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; FX selects the FX track and AMP opens the compressor page, with the sequencer stopped. The same plan on stock 1.74 gives byte-identical frames throughout, as expected while the output is quiet. In further runs with the pattern playing and a full-scale square wave on EXT IN (and, in separate runs, RAT at MAX, or MUP raised and THR lowered), the receive buffer's MAIN words peaked around -30 dBFS, well below the threshold, so the inverted label could not be captured.

captures.plan: DTBOOT_STEPS=1 DTBOOT_PNG_DIR=out dtboot mr74.syx --instr 8800M --every 1000M --press NO@4500M:80M --press NO@5300M:80M --press NO@6100M:80M --press NO@6900M:80M --press FX@7500M:40M --press AMP@8000M:40M
